title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 27-Inch Solid Brass Euro Hook Carolina Collection | Satin Nickel | Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient roll storage without drilling with this freestanding toilet tissue stand for the bathroom in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms. The freestanding design requires no wall mounting, making it a smart choice when wall space is limited. A European style hook (Euro style) helps you swap toilet paper rolls quickly.

Highlights:
- Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Crafted from solid brass
- Heavy base helps prevent tipping
- Coordinates with the Carolina collection and other transitional bathroom hardware
- Multiple designer finish options available

Specs:
- Category: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stands
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 27 in H x 8 in L x 6 in W
- Weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included items: Toilet tissue stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
